# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

As this repository powers a personal portfolio and engineering platform, security updates are applied continuously to the default production branch.

| Branch / Release | Supported          |
| ---------------- | ------------------ |
| `main`           | :white_check_mark: |
| `develop`        | :white_check_mark: |
| Legacy branches  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, sensitive data exposure, or infrastructure misconfiguration:

1. **Do not create a public GitHub issue.**
2. Please privately disclose the vulnerability by submitting a report through [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/oliverslater/oliverslater.github.io/security/advisories/new) or by using the website [Contact Form](https://oliverslater.com/contact/).
3. Please include:
   - A clear description of the vulnerability.
   - Exact steps or proof of concept (PoC) to reproduce the issue.
   - Any suggested mitigations or remediation steps.

Reports are reviewed promptly and remediated via emergency hotfix commits.
